William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

Gnomic Verses

Abstinence sows sand all over

X
A
BSTINENCE
 sows sand all over
The ruddy limbs and flaming hair,
But Desire gratified
Plants fruits of life and beauty there.
